data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Qamar’ meaning moon. The name Qamariyyah signifies the one who embodies the radiance and beauty of the moon. The name Qamariyyah carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qamariyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
